taskId.description: The task's id, as list_tasks or list_agents answered it.

name.description: Its new name, as the sidebar shows it.

repository.description: The GitHub repository its agents work in, as owner/name, which the workspace's GitHub installation must reach; null for none.

pinned.description: true to pin it in the member's sidebar, false to unpin it; their pin alone, no other member's.

priority.description: How much the task matters; none for a task no one has weighed yet.

assignee.description: The member the task is assigned to, who is on it now, by their mention link as list_tasks or another read names them, `[@Name](https://vespin.dev/<workspace>/person/<id>)`, or its address alone; a member of the task's workspace. null for no one.

sectionId.description: The sidebar section the member keeps it in, by the id list_tasks or create_section answered; it leaves the section it stood in and lands at the top of this one. null takes it out of its section, back under Tasks.

parentTaskId.description: The task to make it a child of, by the id list_tasks answered: a task of your workspace working in the same repository, and neither this task nor one of its sub-tasks; where its agents run stays its own. null takes it out from under its parent, to stand at the top.

add.description: Tasks to add to its blocked-by (the tasks it waits on), by the id list_tasks answered.

remove.description: Tasks to take away from its blocked-by (the tasks it waits on); one that is not there is left as it is.

blockedBy.description: Its blocked-by (the tasks it waits on), changed: tasks to add and tasks to take away, each a task of your workspace.

add.description: Tasks to add to its blocks (the tasks that wait on it), by the id list_tasks answered.

remove.description: Tasks to take away from its blocks (the tasks that wait on it); one that is not there is left as it is.

blocks.description: Its blocks (the tasks that wait on it), changed: tasks to add and tasks to take away, each a task of your workspace.
